content.text: The route is `/api/v1/files/:path`, but the stored path lacks `files/`.

candidates.explanation: The stored and returned path is `/${apiPrefix}/v1/${file.filename}`. It leaves out the `files` segment. The download route is `@Controller({path:'files', version:'1'})` with `@Get(':path')`, so the real URL is `/{apiPrefix}/v1/files/{filename}`. The returned link points to `/api/v1/<filename>`, which no route handles, so it returns 404 even though the file is on disk.

fix.description: Include the `files` controller path segment in the stored path.
